rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The supreme similitude means there is no god but God: His oneness and denial of every other deity.
rows.anchor: له التوحيد، ونفي كل إله سواه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ascribe to God daughters whom they themselves dislike.
rows.anchor: أي يجعلون لله البنات اللاتي يكرهونهن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In أن لهم الحسنى, أن replaces الكذب: they claim a good reward despite their shameful act.
rows.anchor: (أن) بدل من (الكذب) المعنى وتصف ألسنتهم أن لهم الحسنى،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لا is a rebuttal: their deed has earned them the Fire; جرم means their act has incurred it.
rows.anchor: المعنى - والله أعلم - ليس ذلك كما وصفوا، جرم أن لهم النار

rows.speaker: قطرب
rows.claim: Qutrub parses أن in لا جرم أن لهم النار as nominative, meaning that the Fire is theirs.
rows.anchor: ذكر ذلك قطرب، وقال المعنى أن لهم النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Four vocalized forms of مفرطون are reported, with different meanings depending on the form.
rows.anchor: فيها أربعة أوجه: (مفرطون) بإسكان الفاء وفتح الراء،

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses forms as abandoned or hastened; the root means going ahead, hence they are brought forward into Hell.
rows.anchor: فأما تفسير (مفرطون) و (مفرطون) فجاء عن ابن عباس،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading from farraṭū means they neglected the afterlife in worldly life, supported by the confession of neglecting God's due.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ مفرطون، فالمعنى أنه وصف لهم بأنهم فرطوا في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading from afrata means they exceeded in disobedience to God.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ مفرطون، فالمعنى على أنهم أفرطوا في معصية الله،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With رحمة in the accusative, it is a purpose complement: the Book was sent for guidance and mercy.
rows.anchor: بنصب (رحمة) المعنى: وما أنزلنا عليك الكتاب إلا هدى ورحمة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, guidance and mercy describe the Book alongside its purpose of clarifying what people disputed.
rows.anchor: ويجوز: وهدى ورحمة في هذا الموضع، المعنى: وما أنزلنا عليك الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sibawayh and al-Khalil distinguish giving someone a drink from providing water, though both forms may mean the same.
rows.anchor: قال سيبويه والخليل سقيته كما تقول ناولته فشرب. وأسقيته جعلت له سقيا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed verse uses سقى and أسقى; the author says its wording can support either account.
rows.anchor: سقى قومي بني مجد وأسقى. . . نميرا والقبائل من هلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anʿām is a collective noun that may be masculine or feminine; another verse says what is in their bellies.
rows.anchor: والأنعام لفظه لفظ جمع، وهو اسم للجنس يذكر ويؤنث،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Milk emerging between dung and blood demonstrates a power that only God can exercise.
rows.anchor: أن في إخراجه اللبن (من بين فرث ودم) دليلا على قدرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fruits of palms and grapes are a sign of God's oneness; سكر is interpreted as wine from before its prohibition, and good provision as edible grapes and dates.
rows.anchor: وقالوا في تفسير قوله: (سكرا ورزقا حسنا) إنه الخمر من قبل أن تحرم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes سكر as food and cites an unattributed line using سكرا; the author says the wine interpretation fits better.
rows.anchor: جعلت أعراض الكرام سكرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بيوت with ḍamma follows the regular pattern; kasra is explained by the following yāʾ, though Basran grammarians reject that pattern.
rows.anchor: فمن قرأ بيوتا بالضم فهو القياس، مثل كعب وكعوب وقلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wahy includes communication and understanding, prophetic revelation and inspiration; God inspires creatures to seek benefit and avoid harm.
rows.anchor: ومعنى الوحي في اللغة على وجهين يرجعان إلى معنى الإعلام والإفهام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God inspired the bee to build homes and eat varied fruits, making its paths easy; it turns sour and bitter food into honey of varied colors and healing.
rows.anchor: فذكر من ذلك أمر النحل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some age until senility takes their reason, becoming ignorant after knowledge; this displays God's power to reverse knowledge into ignorance.
rows.anchor: منكم من يكبر ويسن حتى يذهب عقله خرفا فيصير بعد أن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Life and death belong to God, and even the best food cannot extend a person's allotted lifespan.
rows.anchor: وأن الإنسان قد يتغذى بالأغذية التي يتعمد فيها الغاية في الصلاح والبقاء،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Owners do not share wealth equally with slaves although both are human; this rebukes people for assigning provision to God and idols while refusing to share with equals.
rows.anchor: وأنتم لا تسوون بينكم فيما ملكت أيمانكم، وأنتم كلكم بشر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The bound hand and the hand spread fully mean neither be miserly nor spend extravagantly.
rows.anchor: معناه لا تبخل ولا تسرف.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: فتقعد is subjunctive as the consequence of the prohibition; محسورا describes someone exhausted by overburdening himself.
rows.anchor: (فتقعد) منصوب على جواب النهي، و (محسورا) أي قد بالغت في الحمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: خشية إملاق is a purpose complement and إملاق means poverty; people buried newborn daughters fearing poverty, but God guarantees provision for children and parents.
rows.anchor: (خشية إملاق) منصوب لأنه مفعول له، والإملاق الفقر،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fatḥa reading خطأ means an unsound act or failure to hit the mark; a poetic line witnesses خطئوا الصواب.
rows.anchor: والناس يلحون الأمير إذا هم. . . خطئوا الصواب ولا يلام المرشد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation of the heavens, earth, and what lies between gives signs of oneness more astonishing than the Cave story.
rows.anchor: نشاهد من خلق السماوات والأرض وما بينهما مما يدل على توحيد الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about whether the Cave and al-Raqim were astonishing signs is answered by saying their story will be made clear.
rows.anchor: أي: حتى نبين قصتهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Awaw means they went to the cave and made it their refuge; fitya is a collective plural like ghilma and sabiyaa, but the pattern is not productive.
rows.anchor: ومعنى أووا إليه صاروا إليه وجعلوه مأواهم، والفتية جمع فتى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask for mercy meaning forgiveness and provision, and for guidance toward what draws them near God.
rows.anchor: أي أعطنا من عندك رحمة، أي مغفرة ورزقا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another vocalization of رشدا is possible, but رشدا suits the verse-ending pattern and means guidance toward what brings them near God.
rows.anchor: يجوز في (رشدا) (رشدا) إلا أنه لا يقرأ بها ههنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Striking on their ears means preventing sound from reaching them, since hearing wakes a sleeper; thus God put them to sleep.
rows.anchor: معنى (ضربنا على آذانهم) منعناهم - أن يسمعوا، لأن النائم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عددا may be a cognate accusative or adjective meaning countable years; counting emphasizes a large number or group rather than one item.
rows.anchor: و (عددا) منصوب على ضربين: أحدهما على المصدر، المعنى نعد عددا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raised them from sleep; anyone brought from death to life or sleep to wakefulness is called raised and released from restraint.
rows.anchor: ويقال لكل من خرج من الموت إلى الحياة أو من النوم إلى الانتباه مبعوث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-amad means a limit or term; its accusative may be a specification, governed by أحصى, or linked with لبثوا.
rows.anchor: الأمد الغاية، و (أمدا) منصوب على نوعين، وهو على التمييز منصوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths say they would have spoken an unjust falsehood by invoking another deity; شططا is a cognate accusative from شط and أشط, to act unjustly.
rows.anchor: (شططا). منصوب على المصدر، المعنى لقد قلنا إذن قول شطط.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed poem uses أشطت of unjust excess and witnesses this verb's meaning.
rows.anchor: ألا يا لقومي قد أشطت عواذلي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths condemn their people's worship of other gods and demand clear proof for that worship; لولا means هلا.
rows.anchor: أنكر الفتية عبادة قومهم، وأن يعبدوا مع الله غيره،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما is accusative: if they leave their people and what they worship besides God, they will not abandon worship of Him; the cave becomes their refuge.
rows.anchor: موضع (ما) نصب، المعنى إذا اعتزلتموهم واعتزلتم ما يعبدون إلا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God spreads provision from His mercy and prepares an accommodation; both vowel patterns of مرفق are known, with kasra more common and better for the hand.
rows.anchor: وذكر قطرب وغيره من أهل اللغة اللغتين جميعا في مرفق الأمر ومرفق اليد.

rows.speaker: الأصمعي
rows.claim: Al-Asmaʿi says he knows only the kasra-on-mīm, fatḥa-on-fāʾ pattern for مرفق.
rows.anchor: قال الأصمعي: لا أعرف غير هدا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tazāwar has several readings, including forms without alif; its origin is تتزاور with tāʾ assimilated into zāy.
rows.anchor: والأصل فيه تتزاور فأدغمت التاء في الزاي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For تقرضهم, the kasra reading is established and means the sun turns away from them and leaves them.
rows.anchor: والكسر القراءة عليه، وتأويله تعدل عنهم وتتركهم.

rows.speaker: ذو الرمة
rows.claim: Dhu al-Rumma uses يقرضن for leaving or turning away, witnessing this sense of تقرضهم.
rows.anchor: إلى ظعن يقرضن أقواز مشرف. . . شمالا وعن أيمانهن الفوارس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The root qarḍ means cutting and separating, as in asking someone to cut off a dirham.
rows.anchor: وأصل القرض القطع والتفرقة بين الأشياء،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fajwa means a spacious open area.
rows.anchor: أي في متسع منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim that the cave faced the Pleiades and so received no sunlight is unclear; God made the sun avoid them at sunrise and sunset.
rows.anchor: قيل إن باب الكهف كان بإزاء بنات نعش، فلذلك لم تكن الشمس تطلع عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most language has المهتدي with yāʾ; the codex omits it here, unlike al-Aʿraf, and noun yāʾ deletion is permitted while verbal deletion would mark jussive mood.
rows.anchor: وحذف الياء جائز في الأسماء خاصة ولا يجوز في الأفعال،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aiqāẓ means awake and ruqūd means asleep; a rajaz poet uses أيقاظا for the awake.
rows.anchor: الأيقاظ: المنتبهون، والرقود النيام،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation says their eyes were open; the author favors frequent turning as the reason they appear awake, confirmed by the verse.
rows.anchor: وقيل لكثرة تقلبهم يظن أنهم غير نيام، ويدل عليه (ونقلبهم ذات اليمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb تحسبهم is reported with two vocalizations; الوصيد means the house's courtyard.
rows.anchor: ويجوز وتحسبهم، وتحسبهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kasra on the wāw in لو اطلعت breaks adjacent sukūns and is more original; ḍamma is also allowed. فرارا is a cognate accusative and رعبا a specification.
rows.anchor: والكسر أجود، لأن الواو ساكنة والطاء ساكنة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation says their long hair and nails would frighten anyone who saw them.
rows.anchor: وقيل في التفسير إنهم طالت شعورهم جدا وأظفارهم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wariq has four vowel patterns, with kasra on wāw the least acceptable; qāf may assimilate into kāf.
rows.anchor: فيها أربعة أوجه - بفتح الواو وكسر الراء، وبورقكم بتسكين الراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أيها is nominative as a topic meaning which inhabitants of the city; أزكى is its predicate and طعاما a specification.
rows.anchor: (أيها) مرفوع بالابتداء، ومعنى (أيها أزكى طعاما) أي أي أهلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أزكى طعاما may mean lawful food, since most townspeople were Magians who did not properly slaughter animals, or food not obtained unlawfully.
rows.anchor: وقيل: إن تأويل (أزكى طعاما) أحل طعاما،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second interpretation is food not taken by usurpation or from an illicit source.
rows.anchor: وقيل: (أزكى طعاما) أي طعاما لم يؤخذ من غصب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In فليأتكم, the lām is read with sukūn; kasra is permitted.
rows.anchor: وفليأتكم - بإسكان اللام وكسرها - والقراءة بإسكان اللام.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ولا يشعرن بكم means let no one know of you; if the messenger is discovered, he should not expose his companions to danger.
rows.anchor: قيل لا يعلمن بكم، أي إن ظهر عليه فلا يوقعن إخوانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rجم means killing by stoning, one of the worst kinds of killing; إذا marks a condition.
rows.anchor: أي يقتلوكم بالرجم، والرجم من أخبث القتل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God disclosed them so deniers of resurrection would know the promise is true and believers grow in faith; إذ may attach to أعثرنا or ليعلموا.
rows.anchor: أي أطلعنا عليهم (ليعلموا أن وعد الله حق)، أي ليعلم الذين يكذبون بالبعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers prevailed after the youths were discovered; their proposal to build a mosque indicates belief in resurrection.
rows.anchor: هذا يدل - والله أعلم - أنه لما ظهر أمرهم غلب المؤمنون بالبعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Three is nominative as predicate: disputants say the youths are three, with the dog fourth; رجما بالغيب means guesswork, as in Zuhayr's phrase الحديث المرجم.
rows.anchor: (ثلاثة) مرفوع بخبر الابتداء، المعنى سيقول الذين يتنازعون في أمرهم؛

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adding waw in the later count but omitting it earlier has the same meaning; waw may signal that a narrative unit is complete.
rows.anchor: وقد يجوز أن يكون الواو يدخل ليدل على انقطاع القصة وأن الشيء قد تم.

rows.speaker: زهير
rows.claim: Zuhayr's word المرجم describes conjectural speech and witnesses رجما بالغيب.
rows.anchor: وما الحرب إلا ما علمتم وذقتمو. . . وما هو عنها بالحديث المرجم

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Cave companions were seven and counts himself among the few who know; if authentic, this is highly reliable interpretation.
rows.anchor: روي عن ابن عباس أنه قال، كان أصحاب الكهف سبعة، وأنا من القليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should relate only the revealed apparent account and should not ask the People of the Book about the companions.
rows.anchor: أي لا تأت في أمرهم بغير ما أوحي إليك، أي أفت في قصتهم بالظاهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Except by God's will, one should never promise an act; remembering a missed qualification calls for saying إن شاء الله.
rows.anchor: موضع (أن) نصب، المعنى: لا تقولن إني أفعل أبدا إلا بمشيئة الله،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer asks God for signs and proofs of prophethood clearer in guidance than the Cave story.
rows.anchor: أي قل عسى أن يعطيني من الآيات والدلالات على النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سنين may be accusative as the time after the number, appositionally, or as an adjective of مائة; a poetic example makes an adjective describe a number in sense.
rows.anchor: جائز أن يكون (سنين) نصبا، وجائز أن تكون جرا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author prefers a report from God of the actual duration over the disputants' guesses, making the full number a stronger sign.
rows.anchor: ويجوز - وهو الأجود عندي - أنه إخبار عن الله أخبرهم بطول لبثهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nine are not nine nights or hours: the number's unit need not be repeated once established.
rows.anchor: فلا يكون على معنى وازدادوا تسع ليال، ولا تسع ساعات،

rows.speaker: أبو العباس محمد بن يزيد
rows.claim: Abu al-Abbas explains ten as ten periods, each a day and night; Arabs count nights prominently, and the feminine form shows they are not months.
rows.anchor: قال أبو العباس محمد بن يزيد: (وعشرا) معناه وعشر مدد،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Scholars agree أبصر به وأسمع means how perfectly seeing and hearing He is; God knows the Cave companions' story.
rows.anchor: أجمعت العلماء أن معناه ما أسمعه وأبصره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ولا يشرك may be read as prohibition; تشرك may address the listener and prohibit ascribing unseen knowledge to anyone.
rows.anchor: قرئت: (ولا يشرك) على النهي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The third-person reading means God shares His unseen with no one, as stated in the verse about revealing the unseen.
rows.anchor: فأعلم عز وجل أنه لا يشرك في حكمه مما يخبر به من الغيب أحدا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A strong legal reading forbids judges from deciding except by God's rule or its indication, lest they share authority to prescribe law.
rows.anchor: لا يجوز أن يحكم حاكم إلا بما حكم الله، أو بما يدل عليه حكم الله،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ملتحدا means a place to turn aside to or refuge; no escape exists from God's commands and prohibitions, and no one alters His reports or commands.
rows.anchor: أي لن تجد معدلا عن أمره ونهيه، ولا ملجأ إلا إليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بالغداة والعشي is better according to all scholars because غدوة is definite and normally cannot take the article.
rows.anchor: وقرئت بالغدوة والعشي، وبالغداة والعشي أجود في قول جميع العلماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers call on God with oneness and sincerity, seeking only Him in worship.
rows.anchor: أي يدعونه بالتوحيد والإخلاص له، ويعبدونه يريدون وجهه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not turn your eyes from believers toward people of status; pagan leaders asked the Prophet to distance poor freedmen, including Khabbab, Suhayb, Ammar, and Bilal.
rows.anchor: يعنون خبابا، وصهيبا وعمارا - وبلالا ومن أشبههم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heedless person's affair was فرطا, meaning neglect and putting incapacity first.
rows.anchor: أي كان أمره التفريط، والتفريط تقديم العجز.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The truth is what the Prophet brought from his Lord; believe or disbelieve is a warning, not a command, and the following verses explain each group's fate.
rows.anchor: هذا الكلام ليس بأمر لهم، ما فعلوه منه فهم فيه مطيعون،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أعتدنا means prepared as permanent provision; عتاد is something fixed and lasting.
rows.anchor: معنى أعتدنا جعلناها عتادا لهم كما تقول: جعلت هذا عدة لهذا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A suradiq is any enclosure around something, such as a tent curtain or surrounding wall.
rows.anchor: والسرادق كل ما أحاط بشيء نحو الشقة في المضرب والحائط المشتمل على الشيء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhl is molten metal; it is also interpreted as oil dregs or wound pus, and the drink scorches faces from its heat.
rows.anchor: وقيل المهل: دردي الزيت أيضا. وقيل المهل صديد الجرح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرتفقا is a specification and can mean an abode; linguists also define it as a leaning place, witnessed by an unattributed poem.
rows.anchor: وقال أهل اللغة (مرتفقا): متكأ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There are three possible predicates of إن الذين آمنوا: an omitted منهم, أولئك لهم جنات عدن, or the sentence about not losing the reward.
rows.anchor: ووجه ثالث، أن يكون الخبر (إنا لا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jannat ʿAdn means gardens of residence; another interpretation identifies them among four gardens prepared for God's friends.
rows.anchor: وقيل في التفسير جنات عدن، جنات من الأربع الجنان التي أعدها الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both الداعي and الداع, and both لكنا and لكن أنا, are possible; recitation should follow transmitted readings, not merely what Arabic permits.
rows.anchor: ولزوم الرواية، فإن القراءة سنة، وكلما كثرت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A grammatically possible reading without transmitted authority should not be recited, since that would be an innovation.
rows.anchor: وما جاز في العربية ولم يقرأ به قارئ فلا تقرأن به فإن القراءة به بدعة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Janna means an orchard and lawla means هلا as a rebuke; ما may mean the matter is what God wills or be conditional with an omitted consequence.
rows.anchor: والجنة البستان. ومعنى: (ولولا) هلا، وتأويل الكلام التوبيخ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لا قوة is preferably accusative as absolute negation; nominative is possible and means no one has power except through God.
rows.anchor: الاختيار النصب بغير تنوين على النفي كما قال لا ريب فيه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In إن ترني, أقل is the second object; أنا can emphasize the pronoun or be a separator, and ʿIsa ibn ʿUmar read أقل as predicate of أنا.
rows.anchor: وقد قرأ بها عيسى بن عمر: إن ترني أنا أقل منك مالا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hoped-for better provision from God may be in this world or the next; ḥusbān means reckoning and here punishment for deeds.
rows.anchor: جائز أن يكون أراد في الدنيا، أو في الآخرة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ṣaʿīd is a bare road without plants, and zalaq likewise describes a barren or slippery surface.
rows.anchor: الصعيد الطريق الذي لا نبات فيه، وكذلك الزلق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghawran means sunken or gone underground; ghawr is a verbal noun like ʿadl and riḍā, leaving no trace to pursue.
rows.anchor: معناه غائرا، يقال ماء غور، ومياه غور، وغور مصدر مثل عدل ورضى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's punishment encompassed the produce; the walls remained without roofs after the roofs fell to the ground.
rows.anchor: أي أحاط الله العذاب بثمره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural yansuruhu reflects the collective sense of فئة; the owner also could not defend himself.
rows.anchor: (ينصرونه) محمول على معنى فئة، المعنى ولم يكن له أقوام ينصرونه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الولاية is read with kasra or fatḥa; الحق may modify patronage or God, or be accusative as emphatic cognate, though that reading is unknown.
rows.anchor: وتقرأ (الولاية) - بكسر الواو وفتحها -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At that moment God's patronage becomes clear: He takes care of His friend; ثوابا and عقبا are specifications.
rows.anchor: أي عند ذلك يتيين نصره، ولي الله - يتولى الله إياه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rain nourishes vegetation until it dries into wind-scattered chaff; الرياح is read, and two other forms of تذروه are possible but not recited.
rows.anchor: والهشيم النبات الجاف الذي تسفيه الريح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The example teaches that worldly life passes away, and what has passed is as though it never existed.
rows.anchor: أعلم الله - عز وجل - أن الحياة الدنيا زائلة، ودليل ذلك أن ما مضى منها بمنزلة ما لم يكن،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has power to originate and annihilate all things.
rows.anchor: أي على الإنشاء، والإفناء، مقتدرا.

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan says God was able to bring each thing into being before its creation.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسن: (وكان الله على كل شيء مقتدرا) أي كان مقتدرا عليه قبل كونه.

rows.speaker: سيبويه والخليل
rows.claim: Sibawayh and al-Khalil's view is preferred: كَان describes timeless power; Arabic does not use past كَان for future or present without a tense-shifting particle.
rows.anchor: ومذهب سيبويه والخليل مذهب النحويين الحذاق كما وصفنا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some say God's كان means كائن ويكون, but this conflicts with normal Arabic tense usage.
rows.anchor: من الله بمنزلة كائن ويكون.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أعمالا is a specification after الأخسرين, clarifying the type of loss.
rows.anchor: منصوب على التمييز لأنه إذ قال: (بالأخسرين)، دل على أنه كان منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people meant are disbelievers whose works do not benefit them; another verse says God frustrates the deeds of disbelievers.
rows.anchor: كما قال تعالى: (الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله أضل أعمالهم)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الذين may be genitive as an adjective for الأخسرين or nominative as a new sentence; يحسبون has two readings.
rows.anchor: و (الذين) يصلح أن يكون جرا ورفعأ، فالجر نعت للأخسرين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Firdaws is explained as fertile valleys, a garden, or a Greek or Syriac loanword; the author defines it as a garden containing all garden produce, citing Ḥassān ibn Thābit.
rows.anchor: وإن ثواب الله كل موحد. . . جنان من الفردوس فيها يخلد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Janna also means garden; the believers' Garden contains what gardens hold and what souls desire.
rows.anchor: والجنة أيضا في اللغة البستان، إلا أن الجنة التي يدخلها المؤمنون فيها ما يكون في البساتين،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without a prior divine decree and appointed term, punishment would have remained binding; the term is God's promise of punishment on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: معطوف على (كلمة) المعنى لولا كلمة سبقت وأجل مسمى لكان لزاما،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tasbih before sunrise and sunset means dawn and evening; the night hours are its portions, and the day's ends include noon and afternoon.
rows.anchor: وأطراف النهار الظهر والعصر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source notes a recitation variant for لعلك ترضى.
rows.anchor: ويقرأ ترضى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ثاني عطفه is an accusative circumstantial expression describing someone turning his neck arrogantly while disputing without knowledge.
rows.anchor: و (ثاني) منصوب على الحال، ومعناه التنوين. ومعناه ثانيا عطفه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ذلك may be a topic with بما قدمت يداك as predicate and أن الله in the genitive; another parse makes ذلك a predicate and أن الله nominative, while إن is also possible.
rows.anchor: ولو قرئت (إن) بالكسر لجاز.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship on a حرف means standing precariously at the edge of the religious path without firm commitment; good fortune reassures, but hardship makes him apostatize.
rows.anchor: وحقيقته أنه يعبد الله على حرف الطريقة في الدين، لا يدخل فيه دخول متمكن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good fortune means wealth and livestock; trial means drought and reduced wealth, leading him back to disbelief and idol worship.
rows.anchor: اطمأن بما أصابه ورضي بدينه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hamazāt is the plural of hamza, meaning Satan's assault or prompting, including whispers that distract from God's command.
rows.anchor: واحد الهمزات همزة، وهو مس الشيطان،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Several forms of رب are possible, but only the transmitted رب with kasra and omitted yāʾ should be recited; its yāʾ is omitted in address.
rows.anchor: وهو الذي عليه الناس. . رب بكسر الباء وحذف الياء، والياء حذفت للبداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With ḍamma, رب means O Lord; ربي retains the original form.
rows.anchor: من قال رب بالضم فعلى معنى يا أيها الرب ومن قال ربي فعلى الأصل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At death, those who rejected resurrection ask to return so they may do good with what they left behind.
rows.anchor: يعني به الذين ذكروا قبل هذا الموضع. ودفعوا البعث فأعلم أنه إذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural imperative ارجعون addresses God alone; Arabic uses plural self-reference for a figure of great status.
rows.anchor: وهو يريد الله - عز وجل - وحده، فجاء الخطاب في المسألة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كلا is a rebuke and alert; barzakh is the barrier between death and resurrection.
rows.anchor: ما بين موت الميت وبعثه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يوم is annexed to a verb because time nouns can be annexed to verbs.
rows.anchor: لأن أسماء الزمان تضاف إلى الأفعال والبرزخ في اللغة الحاجز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse may refer to the first blast or after the second; ṣūr is a horn, while the lexicographers' claim that it means forms is weak.
rows.anchor: قيل: هذا في النفخة الأولى ويجوز أن يكون بعد النفخة الثانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No mutual questioning does not conflict with other verses: Judgment has changing stages; questions may seek information or rebuke, and day can mean a span of time.
rows.anchor: فإن يوم القيامة مقداره خمسون ألف سنة، ففيه أزمنة وأحوال.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The kasra in إني جزيتهم is better: God rewarded them for patience, then says they are successful; fatḥa is also sound with other meanings.
rows.anchor: الكسر أجود لأن الكسر على معنى إني جزيتهم بما صبروا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كم is accusative with لبثتم; عدد سنين is governed by كم, and doubled tāʾ is permitted in question and answer.
rows.anchor: في موضع نصب بقوله: (لبثتم)، و (عدد سنين) منصوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لبثنا is reported with two readings; العادين means angels who kept count of their stay.
rows.anchor: أي فاسأل الملائكة الذين يحفظون عدد ما لبثنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement means they remained only a little while.
rows.anchor: معناه ما لبثتم إلا قليلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yuzjī means drives, yualif joins scattered clouds into one, and rukāman piles clouds together; wadq is rain.
rows.anchor: معنى: (يزجي) يسوق، (ثم يؤلف بينه) أي يجعل القطع المتفرقة من السحاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reading خلاله is broader and better than خلله; khilāl is a plural like mountains from mountain.
rows.anchor: ويقرأ من خلله، وخلاله أعم وأجود في القراءة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cloud may be plural or collective singular; بينه can refer to the whole cloud, as a region name can contain multiple places.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون السحاب واحدا إلا أنه قال بينه لكثرته،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means hail-bearing clouds like mountains, or an amount of hail as great as mountains, as in mountains of wealth.
rows.anchor: من مقدار جبال من برد كما تقول عند فلان جبال مال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lightened reading of ينزل is allowed; Abu Jaʿfar alone read يذهب بالأبصار, grammatically weak though the yāʾ form with ḍamma is allowed.
rows.anchor: وقرأ أبو جعفر المدني: يذهب بالأبصار، ولم يقرأ بها غيره،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sana is lightning's light; readings distinguish برق as the amount of lightning from برقة as one flash, like an action once versus its measure.
rows.anchor: ومعنى (سنا برقه) ضوء برقه،

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan says night or day offers another chance for remembrance and gratitude if the other period was missed.
rows.anchor: قال الحسن: من فاته عمله من التذكر والشكر كان له في الليل مستعتب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Linguists explain خلفة as one period following another; Zuhayr's word خلفة witnesses this use.
rows.anchor: وقال أهل اللغة خلفة يجيء هذا في أثر هذا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the periods as alternating opposites, supported by the verse on creation and alternation of night and day.
rows.anchor: وجاء أيضا في التفسير خلفة مختلفان كما قال الله عز وجل:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servants of the Merciful walk with composure and answer ignorant people peacefully; عباد الرحمن may take its predicate from the later promise of upper chambers or the following relative clause.
rows.anchor: أي يمشون بسكينة ووقار وحلم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كسفا means separate pieces of cloud; wadq is rain emerging through the cloud's gaps.
rows.anchor: (ويجعله كسفا) أي قطعا من السحاب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates clouds, revives earth, and sends winds, proving power beyond human ability and ability to resurrect the dead.
rows.anchor: وذلك كله دليل على القدرة التي يعجز عنها المخلوقون، وأنه قادر على إحياء الموتى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mublisīn means cut off and despairing before rain comes; Qutrub parses the repeated من قبل differently, while al-Akhfash takes it as emphasis, preferred by the author.
rows.anchor: وقال الأخفش وغيره من البصريين: تكرير قبل على جهة التوكيد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed line uses مر الرياح for the passage of winds, illustrating the equivalence of the rain's sending and the rain itself.
rows.anchor: تسفهت أعاليها مر الرياح النواسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing means receiving and acting on what is heard; refusal is like not hearing or seeing.
rows.anchor: وجعل الإسماع ههنا إسماعا إذا قبل وعمل بما سمع،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The genitive العمي is the transmitted reading; accusative is grammatically possible only if supported, since unsupported readings are innovation.
rows.anchor: فالقراءة بالجر، فأما النصب فإن كانت فيها رواية، وإلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People move from weakness as embryos to strength in youth, then to weakness and gray hair after youth.
rows.anchor: تأويله أنه خلقكم من النطف في حال ضعف ثم قواكم في حال الشبيبة

rows.speaker: ابن عمر
rows.claim: Ibn Umar reports the Prophet corrected his reading من ضعف to ḍamma; the author prefers ḍamma on the basis of transmission.
rows.anchor: وقد قرئت بفتح الضاد، والاختيار الضم، للرواية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour means the time when Resurrection occurs; criminals swear they remained in their graves only an hour, lying without proof.
rows.anchor: والساعة في القرآن على معنى الساعة التي تقوم فيها القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book of God in which the knowledgeable say they remained until resurrection means God's knowledge fixed in the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: أي في علم الله المثبت في اللوح المحفوظ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's promise of victory over the enemy and establishment of Islam is true; doubters should not provoke the Prophet from his religion.
rows.anchor: أي إن ما وعدك الله من النصر على عدوك حق، وإظهار دين الإسلام حق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: فيموتوا is subjunctive as the consequence of negation: they will not be sentenced to death and so die.
rows.anchor: (فيموتوا) نصب، وعلامة النصب سقوط النون، وهو جواب النفي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their plea promises good deeds if released; God rebukes them for having had ample time to remember.
rows.anchor: معناه أو لم نعمركم العمر الذي يتذكر فيه من تذكر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time is interpreted as sixty years, sixty to seventy, seventeen years, or forty years.
rows.anchor: وجاء في التفسير: لقد أعذر الله إلى عبد عمره ستين سنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author says most interpretations take the warning messenger as the Prophet; others identify it with gray hair.
rows.anchor: والقول الأول أن النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - النذير أكثر التفسير عليه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The common reading is genitive; عالم غيب without tanwīn is also allowed with the sense of knowing or already knowing the unseen.
rows.anchor: القراءة الكثيرة بالخفض ويجوز عالم غيب السماوات على معنى يعلم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: خلفاء is the plural of خليفة: later peoples succeed earlier peoples and learn from them; a disbeliever bears the recompense of disbelief, and maqt is the strongest hatred.
rows.anchor: جمع خليفة، المعنى جعلكم أمة خلفت من قبلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A blind person cannot distinguish an eyelid; if God blinded them and turned them from the road, they could not see where to go.
rows.anchor: المطموس الأعمى الذي لا يتبين له جفن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مكانتهم and مكاناتهم are both readings; مكانة and مكان have the same meaning, and inability to move means no going or returning.
rows.anchor: والمكانة والمكان في معنى واحد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word has several patterns derived from نكس; long life reverses creation from strength and youth to weakness and old age.
rows.anchor: ومعناه من أطلنا عمره نكسنا خلقه، فصار بدل القوة ضعفا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was not taught poetry, but this does not mean he never recited a poetic line; he is no poet, and the Qur'an is unlike human speech and Arab meters.
rows.anchor: إنما يوجب هذا أن يكون النبي عليه السلام ليس بشاعر، وأن يكون القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is a lasting miraculous sign proving the Prophet's prophethood.
rows.anchor: والقرآن آية معجزة تدل على أن نبوة النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idolaters answer that they worship their patrons only to bring them nearer to God.
rows.anchor: المعنى يقولون لأوليائهم: ما نعبدكم إلا لتقربونا إلى الله زلفى،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not guide the liar and disbeliever; He is exalted above a child, including claims that Jesus or Ezra is His son.
rows.anchor: (إن الله لا يهدي من هو كاذب كفار).

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God wanted a child, He could choose from creation, but He is exalted and is the One, the Irresistible.
rows.anchor: أي تنزيها له عن ذلك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ثم marks sequence: the one soul is Adam and his spouse Eve, made from him before the rest of humankind.
rows.anchor: والنفس الواحدة يعني بها آدم - صلى الله عليه وسلم - وزوجها حواء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A patient person who forgives receives reward; greater desire for reward reflects stronger resolve, and some linguists say forgiveness is better than retaliation.
rows.anchor: أي الصابر يؤتى بصبره ثوابا فكل من زادت رغبته في الثواب فهو أتم عزم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humiliated look may mean seeing Hell from the corner of the eye; others say they are blind but perceive it with their hearts, or steal glances at it.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم إنهم يحشرون عميا فيرون النار بقلوبهم إذا عرضوا عليها،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no refuge from punishment, and people will be unable to deny their sins or the punishment that comes upon them.
rows.anchor: أي ليس لكم مخلص من العذاب، ولا تقدرون أن تنكروا ما تقفون عليه
